paragraphs.text: Dan Sheehan , a.k.a. NOT A WOLF , is an American author and comedy writer living in Los Angeles.

Sheehan has written for several outlets, including The Onion , ClickHole and Netflix. His debut novel I Am Not a Wolf was featured in New York Magazine's "Best of 2021" coverage as one of the best comedy books of the year. It was based on his Twitter account "NOT A WOLF" which is about a wolf who masquerades as a human office worker.
In 2022, he contributed to the Magic Story for Dominaria United . He also contributed creative text to Outlaws of Thunder Junction , Aetherdrift , and Return to Arcavios .

In addition to that, he hosted the comedic Magic: The Gathering podcast, The Commander Sphere with his friend and fellow comedian Rachel Weeks (now of the Command Zone ) from 2019 until 2022 as well as the color pie podcast Pie Break until it ended in 2025.
In 2024, Sheehan collaborated with Wizards of the Coast for the NOT A WOLF Secret Lair drop.
